brief.zh: 把起始电量交给补电函数。看看两个同名的格子各自存了什么，以及计算结果怎样回到主程序。
brief.en: Pass the starting charge to the charging function. See what the two boxes with the same name hold and how the answer comes back to the main program.

concept.zh: 参数、局部变量与返回值
concept.en: Parameters, local variables, and return values

execution.source:
def top_up(charge):
    charge = charge + 3
    return charge

charge = scan()
result = top_up(charge)
say(str(result))

title.en: Hand the charge to the charging function

note.zh: 主程序把电池读数存进自己的格子。
note.en: The main program stores the battery reading in its own box.

label.en: Pass the charge to the function

note.zh: 把括号里那个变量的值交给函数的参数。
note.en: Pass the value in parentheses to the function’s parameter.

note.zh: 屏幕显示主程序收到的新电量。
note.en: The screen shows the new charge the main program received.

note.zh: 括号内的名字是参数。每次调用时，它接收这次交进来的值。
note.en: The name in parentheses is a parameter. It receives a value on each call.

note.zh: 取出参数格里的数，加 3 格，再写回函数自己的格子。
note.en: Take the number in the parameter’s box, add 3, and store it back in the function’s box.

label.en: Return the new charge to the main program

note.zh: return 把算好的数交给正在等待的主程序。
note.en: return hands the new number back to the main program.

title.zh: 参数接住调用时交来的值
title.en: A parameter receives a value when a function is called

body.zh: 调用 top_up(charge) 时，先从主程序的 charge 里读出数值，把这个数交给补电函数。函数把它放进自己的参数 charge。
body.en: In top_up(charge), the main program first reads its charge and passes the number to the function. The function stores that number in its own parameter named charge.

title.zh: 同一个名字可以在两个地方各存一个数
title.en: The same name can hold a value in two places

body.zh: 主程序和补电函数各有一个叫 charge 的格子。函数补 3 格后，函数的格子里是 9，主程序的格子里还是 6。
body.en: The main program and the charging function each have a box named charge. After adding 3, the function’s box holds 9 while the main program’s box still holds 6.

title.zh: 返回值要交回调用的地方
title.en: A return value goes back to the call

body.zh: return charge 把函数算好的值交回主程序。主程序接着运行调用这一行，把收到的值存进 result。
body.en: return charge hands the function’s answer back to the main program. The main program finishes the call by storing the answer in result.

prompt.zh: 主程序的 charge 是 6。函数补 3 格后，返回值和主程序里的 charge 各是多少？
prompt.en: The main program’s charge is 6. After the function adds 3, what is the return value and what is in the main program’s charge?

options.zh: 返回 9，主程序的 charge 是 6。
options.en: It returns 9, and the main program’s charge is 6.

options.zh: 返回 9，主程序的 charge 是 9。
options.en: It returns 9, and the main program’s charge is 9.

options.zh: 返回 6，主程序的 charge 是 9。
options.en: It returns 6, and the main program’s charge is 9.

feedback.zh: 函数在自己的 charge 里算出 9 并返回。主程序的原读数是 6，返回的 9 存进 result。
feedback.en: The function calculates 9 in its own charge and returns it. The main program keeps its original reading of 6 and stores the returned 9 in result.

caption.zh: 主程序把电池读到的 6 存进 charge。
caption.en: The main program stores the battery reading of 6 in charge.

caption.zh: 主程序把 6 交给补电函数，函数的参数 charge 接到 6。
caption.en: The main program hands over 6, and the function receives it in its parameter named charge.

caption.zh: 函数在自己的格子里加 3。两个同名的格子现在分别是 6 和 9。
caption.en: The function adds 3 in its own box. The two boxes with the same name now hold 6 and 9.

caption.zh: return 把 9 交回主程序。
caption.en: return hands 9 back to the main program.

caption.zh: 主程序把返回的 9 存进 result，charge 中仍是原读数 6。
caption.en: The main program stores the returned 9 in result. Its charge still holds the original reading of 6.
